text: From run chemical-kinetics/20261117-2, collect-1 (the Cantera bundle standing alone), two things in the design role's paths. (1) bundle-cantera-1 in meta_agent/failures.jsonl at 569664d: install_cantera's contract lists the error unavailable and its errors/ has no unavailable.json, and bundle check B16 passed it; asked whether B16 should read each declared error against its file.
